description: List and optionally filter all top-level FRAME nodes in a Figma file. Returns exact page/name/node-id data, nullable dimensions, current file metadata, completeness, request ID, and rate-limit proof. Requires file_content:read.

file_key.description: File key parsed from the Figma URL.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive page or frame-name substring.

name: list_frames
